capabilities: Import JSON files or pasted JSON as Markdown notes with properties
Render statblock cards with scoped CSS that survives theme changes
Receive direct website exports through the clipboard
Roll clickable dice notation such as 1d8+3
Review roll details and history in a dockable dice-results view
extras: Fully local and offline: no network requests, account, analytics, or auto-updater. Direct website transfers are capped at 32 MiB; larger creations use the JSON download flow. Integration contract documented separately in WEBSITE-INTEGRATION.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn RPG Homebrew website exports into searchable Markdown notes with usable, rollable statblocks.

relations.evidence: The website can send an export to Obsidian.

summary: Imports RPG Homebrew JSON into Obsidian as rendered statblock notes and adds clickable dice notation with a roll-history view.
